usedFor: A new Intercom ticket moves a slot or its attendees on Google Calendar.

bestTemplate.name: “New Ticket Created” in Intercom, then “Update Event” in Google Calendar
bestTemplate.why: A ticket can mean a booked call must change, and “Update Event” can notify guests.

watchOut: “Update Event” needs an existing event in a chosen calendar; “Create Calendar” would make one per ticket.
